entries.title: Job 10:1
segments: My soul is weary of my life; I will leave my complaint on my self; I will speak in the bitterness of my soul.

entries.title: Job 10:2
segments: I will say to God, Do not condemn me; make me know why You contend with me.

entries.title: Job 10:3
segments: Is [it] good to You that You should press down, that You should despise the work of Your hands, and shine on the counsel of the wicked?

entries.title: Job 10:4
segments: [Have] You eyes of flesh? Or do You see as a man sees?

entries.title: Job 10:5
segments: [Are] Your days like the days of man? [Are] Your years like man's days,

entries.title: Job 10:6
segments: that You seek out my iniquity, and search for my sin?

entries.title: Job 10:7
segments: You know that I am not wicked; and [there is] none who can deliver out of Your hand.

entries.title: Job 10:8
segments: Your hands have made me and shaped me, together all around; yet You destroy me.

entries.title: Job 10:9
segments: Remember, I beseech You, that You have formed me as the clay; and will You bring me into the dust again?

entries.title: Job 10:10
segments: Have You not poured me out like milk, and curdled me like cheese?

entries.title: Job 10:11
segments: You have clothed me with skin and flesh, and have fenced me with bones and sinews.

entries.title: Job 10:12
segments: You have granted me life and favor, and Your providence has preserved my spirit.

entries.title: Job 10:13
segments: And these have You hidden in Your heart; I know that this [was] with You.

entries.title: Job 10:14
segments: If I sin, then You mark me, and You will not acquit me from my iniquity.

entries.title: Job 10:15
segments: If I am wicked, woe to me; and [if] I am righteous, I will not lift up my head [being] filled with shame, and looking on my affliction.

entries.title: Job 10:16
segments: For it increases! You hunt me as a fierce lion; and again You show Yourself marvelous on me.

entries.title: Job 10:17
segments: You renew Your witnesses against me, and increase Your anger on me; changes and warfare [are] against me.

entries.title: Job 10:18
segments: Why then have You brought me from the womb? Oh that I had given up the spirit, and no eye had seen me!

entries.title: Job 10:19
segments: I should have been as though I had not been; I would have been carried from the womb to the grave.

entries.title: Job 10:20
segments: Are not my days few? Cease [then, and] let me alone, that I may take comfort a little,

entries.title: Job 10:21
segments: before I go, and I shall not return, even to the land of darkness and the shadow of death;

entries.title: Job 10:22
segments: a land of obscurity, the darkness of the shadow of death, without any order, and the shining [is] as darkness.
